controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:40:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:40:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
| STATS total_events = COUNT(*),
        sshd_events = COUNT(*) WHERE process.name == "sshd",
        failed_auth_events = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        success_auth_events = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        pam_unix_events = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*pam_unix*",
        session_events = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*session*",
        first_event = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_event = MAX(@timestamp)
| EVAL window_duration_seconds = DATE_DIFF("second", first_event, last_event)
